description: Header file defining utility structures and functions for generating ninja build commands related to target configuration, including writers for defines, frameworks, weak libraries, include paths, and functions for handling precompiled headers.

classes.name: DefineWriter
classes.description: Handles writing of macro definitions for ninja build commands.

classes.name: FrameworkDirsWriter
classes.description: Handles writing of framework directory paths.

classes.name: WeakLibrariesWriter
classes.description: Handles writing of weak library references.

classes.name: IncludeWriter
classes.description: Handles writing of include directory paths.

methods.name: WriteOneFlag
methods.description: Writes a single compiler or linker flag based on target and substitution info.

methods.name: GetPCHOutputFiles
methods.description: Retrieves output files for precompiled headers.

methods.name: GetGCCPCHOutputExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension for GCC precompiled headers.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHObjectExtension
methods.description: Returns the object file extension for Windows precompiled headers.
